briefs.title: Netherlands - Receiving and stock handover
briefs.purpose: Prepare a draft receiving checklist for a future Netherlands workstream. Use the Rotterdam location label only as a planning reference. Product quantities, receiving arrangements and responsible colleagues remain unconfirmed until the department reviews this brief.
workItems: Create an intake record with empty fields for product reference, purchase reference, arrival date and condition; do not populate it with assumed deliveries.
Define where a reviewer will record packaging condition, visible damage and any difference between the expected and counted items.
Separate items awaiting inspection from items accepted for the next handover, and record who will approve that change of status.
Prepare a handover note that links the inspection record to the relevant stock record without creating live stock movements.
deliverables: Blank receiving checklist with inspection and exception fields.
Draft stock handover note with owner and approval fields left unassigned.
Open questions covering the receiving location and the evidence needed for acceptance.
briefs.nextAction: Ask the production lead to nominate a receiving reviewer and confirm which stock records this template should reference.

briefs.title: France - Sample review and revision control
briefs.purpose: Set up a draft sample review pack for a possible France workstream. The pack should connect feedback to a specific sample version so that comments cannot be mistaken for approval of a different garment or material.
workItems: List the sample reference, revision label, intended review purpose and the measurements or finish details that the reviewer needs to check.
Provide a consistent place for annotated photographs, with separate notes for construction, finish, fit and any unresolved questions.
Record each requested change against the sample version, leaving the proposed owner and completion date blank until they are assigned.
Prepare a comparison checklist for the next sample so that accepted changes and remaining issues can be reviewed together.
deliverables: Sample review cover sheet with version and review-status fields.
Draft revision log linking comments to sample references.
Comparison checklist for a later sample review; no sample is marked approved.
briefs.nextAction: Request the relevant sample references from the production lead before adding photographs or review comments.

briefs.title: United Kingdom - Packaging readiness checklist
briefs.purpose: Build a draft packaging review checklist for a potential United Kingdom workstream. This is an internal preparation document, not a statement that packaging, shipping arrangements or country requirements have already been approved.
workItems: Create a packaging record with space for the garment reference, packaging version, protective materials and the intended review stage.
Check that a reviewer can compare the packed item with the approved product reference and record missing or mismatched components.
Leave label wording and any country-specific requirements as pending review rather than copying unverified wording into the template.
Prepare a small evidence list for photographs, handling observations and the final internal sign-off before any release decision.
deliverables: Packaging readiness checklist with a clear draft status.
Evidence register for photographs and handling-review notes.
Outstanding-review list for label content, materials and release authority.
briefs.nextAction: Ask the production lead which packaging version should be reviewed and who can approve the final pack.

briefs.title: Germany - Quality inspection and exceptions
briefs.purpose: Prepare a draft quality inspection record for a possible Germany workstream. The focus is traceable observations and a clear route for unresolved issues; this brief does not set technical tolerances or claim that any product has passed inspection.
workItems: Create blank fields for product reference, inspection stage, applicable specification version and the person performing the review.
Provide separate checks for seams, fastening function, fabric appearance and consistency with the specification supplied by Design.
Record exceptions using an observation, supporting image reference and proposed follow-up rather than an unexplained pass or fail label.
Require the designated reviewer to identify which exceptions need another inspection before the relevant item can move to its next stage.
deliverables: Draft inspection sheet linked to a specification version.
Exception log with evidence and follow-up fields.
Unassigned review checklist for reinspection and release decisions.
briefs.nextAction: Request the relevant specification version and approved inspection criteria before the department uses this record.

briefs.title: United Arab Emirates - Dispatch handover preparation
briefs.purpose: Prepare an internal dispatch handover outline for a possible United Arab Emirates workstream, using Dubai as the location label shown in the workspace. Shipment details, service providers and release decisions are intentionally left unconfirmed.
workItems: Create empty fields for the product references, internal dispatch reference, recipient role and the person responsible for checking the handover.
List the supporting records that the production reviewer needs, such as a packing record, inspection status and any unresolved product exceptions.
Keep transport arrangements and country-specific documentation as questions for the appropriate internal reviewer; do not treat this checklist as shipping guidance.
Define how the receiving colleague will acknowledge the handover and record missing information without implying that dispatch has already occurred.
deliverables: Draft dispatch handover cover sheet.
Supporting-record checklist with all references pending.
Open-question log for the planned receiving and dispatch roles.
briefs.nextAction: Ask the production lead whether a dispatch review is needed and which internal roles should complete it.

briefs.title: Türkiye - Supplier information and material traceability
briefs.purpose: Create a draft supplier-information checklist for a potential Türkiye workstream. Türkiye is a country-level workspace reference; no city, supplier relationship, production order or manufacturing location is assumed by this document.
workItems: Prepare blank fields for the supplier reference, material reference, information owner and the reason the information is being requested.
List the material details that Design and Production need to compare, including the supplied description, sample version and any supporting references.
Keep supplier claims separate from details that the designated reviewer has checked, and record missing evidence as an open item.
Prepare a handover summary that links reviewed material information to the relevant internal specification without implying supplier approval.
deliverables: Blank supplier-information intake form.
Material traceability register with evidence and review-status fields.
Draft handover summary for the Design and Production reviewers.
briefs.nextAction: Ask the production lead to confirm the information request and assign a reviewer before contacting any supplier.

briefs.title: Netherlands - Campaign message foundation
briefs.purpose: Prepare a draft message foundation for a possible Netherlands campaign. Use it to connect the collection story, intended audience and supporting product facts before anyone prepares channel copy or treats a concept as an approved campaign.
workItems: Write an internal one-sentence campaign objective and identify which product references or collection details will support that objective.
Separate the proposed message from factual product claims, marking any claim that still needs evidence or product-owner confirmation.
Prepare a short tone guide with a clear call to action, avoiding unconfirmed promotions, availability statements or launch dates.
List the copy and visual reviewers needed for approval and leave their names and review dates unassigned until the team agrees them.
deliverables: Draft campaign message sheet with an unapproved status.
Product-claim evidence checklist.
Proposed review route for copy, product details and creative assets.
briefs.nextAction: Ask the brand lead to confirm the campaign objective and nominate the product-fact reviewer.

briefs.title: France - Local copy review pack
briefs.purpose: Build a draft copy review pack for a potential France workstream. The aim is to preserve the intended brand message while allowing an assigned local reviewer to check wording, clarity and context before any copy is released.
workItems: Record the source-copy version and intended placement so that a reviewer can distinguish a headline, caption, product description and supporting note.
Provide side-by-side fields for source wording, proposed local wording, reviewer comments and an explicit approval status.
Flag product names, claims, promotional terms and calls to action that require confirmation rather than assuming a direct translation is suitable.
Link each copy item to its planned visual reference and record any spacing or text-length issue that Creative should review.
deliverables: Draft source-and-local-copy comparison sheet.
Terminology and product-claim questions for the assigned reviewer.
Copy-to-visual handover checklist with no items marked released.
briefs.nextAction: Ask the brand lead to assign a local copy reviewer and confirm which source-copy version should be used.

briefs.title: United Kingdom - Channel content planning
briefs.purpose: Create a draft channel plan for a possible United Kingdom campaign. This working document organizes content ideas and dependencies; it does not confirm a publication schedule, paid placement, promotional offer or stock availability.
workItems: List each proposed content item with its intended channel, audience purpose, product reference and the source assets required to prepare it.
Provide empty fields for draft owner, intended publication date, copy status and visual status rather than inventing a campaign calendar.
Check that proposed captions and calls to action connect to a suitable destination whose product information still needs review before release.
Define a final review step for copy, visual usage rights and current product details, and record blockers separately from completed work.
deliverables: Blank channel content planner with draft examples only.
Content dependency list for copy, assets and destination pages.
Pre-release review checklist for the brand lead.
briefs.nextAction: Ask the brand lead which channels and content objectives should be included before adding proposed dates.

briefs.title: Germany - Campaign asset quality review
briefs.purpose: Prepare a draft asset quality review for a possible Germany workstream. The focus is consistency between the message, visual version and destination page, with every item staying in draft until the designated reviewers sign it off.
workItems: Create an asset register containing a reference, version, intended placement, copy reference and the person who will own the review.
Check that product appearance, color naming and any visible product details match the product information supplied for review.
Provide fields for crop issues, readable text placement, alternative-text suggestions and missing usage-rights references.
Record approval separately for the visual, associated copy and destination page so that one approved component does not imply a complete campaign approval.
deliverables: Draft campaign asset register with version references.
Visual and accessibility review checklist.
Combined release checklist showing the status of each dependency.
briefs.nextAction: Ask the brand lead to identify the current asset and copy versions before the quality review begins.

briefs.title: United Arab Emirates - Partner content handover
briefs.purpose: Outline a draft partner-content handover for a potential United Arab Emirates workstream. Dubai is only the workspace location reference. No partnership, content booking, usage permission or release date is confirmed by this template.
workItems: Prepare fields for the proposed content purpose, intended audience, partner reference and the internal role responsible for coordinating the review.
List the visual and copy assets proposed for sharing, including their version references and the usage-permission questions that remain open.
Provide space for local wording and context review without making assumptions about audience preferences or treating draft wording as approved.
Create an explicit acknowledgement and sign-off step for both the internal content pack and any returned partner material before publication is considered.
deliverables: Draft partner-content handover cover sheet.
Asset and permission reference list.
Unassigned review checklist for proposed and returned content.
briefs.nextAction: Ask the brand lead whether a partner-content brief is needed and which internal reviewer should own it.

briefs.title: Türkiye - Market asset register and localization questions
briefs.purpose: Prepare a draft asset register for a possible Türkiye workstream. Use the country-level workspace reference without adding an assumed city or office. The register should make local content questions visible before any market-specific material is approved.
workItems: List proposed asset references and identify the content purpose, source-copy version and intended placement for each item.
Provide fields for the local reviewer to record wording, image-context and destination-page questions rather than assuming that existing assets are ready to reuse.
Track requested changes with the relevant asset version so that replaced or outdated files cannot be confused with the latest draft.
Keep the release status pending until the brand lead has confirmed the visual, copy, product claims and usage references together.
deliverables: Draft market asset register with clear version labels.
Localization question log for an assigned reviewer.
Pending-release checklist linking copy, visuals and destination pages.
briefs.nextAction: Ask the brand lead to select the initial assets and assign a local content reviewer before adding market copy.

briefs.title: Netherlands - Community feedback review
briefs.purpose: Prepare a draft feedback review for a possible Netherlands community workstream. Use anonymized themes rather than personal customer records, and distinguish an observation from a confirmed issue or an approved change to the customer experience.
workItems: Create a theme log with space for the source channel, a short anonymized summary, the review owner and the question that needs a response.
Separate product questions, website experience comments and community ideas so that each theme can reach the appropriate internal team.
Provide fields for supporting references and the next review step without copying names, private messages or contact details into this starter document.
Prepare an internal handover summary that records the theme, proposed follow-up and status while leaving any response commitment unconfirmed.
deliverables: Blank anonymized feedback theme log.
Draft routing guide for product, website and community themes.
Unassigned handover summary for a later feedback review.
briefs.nextAction: Ask the community lead to confirm which feedback sources may be reviewed and nominate the first theme reviewer.

briefs.title: France - Community partnership intake
briefs.purpose: Create a draft intake brief for a possible France community partnership. This is a way to organize questions before outreach or approval; it does not confirm a partner, event, collaboration, audience commitment or agreed deliverable.
workItems: Prepare empty fields for the proposed collaboration purpose, community benefit, partner reference and internal coordination role.
List the questions that a reviewer should resolve about audience relevance, participation format, content responsibilities and practical support needs.
Record image and story usage questions separately, leaving all permissions pending until the appropriate people have reviewed them.
Prepare a decision note that separates open questions, proposed follow-up and an eventual approval decision instead of presenting an idea as an agreed partnership.
deliverables: Blank community partnership intake form.
Draft review questions covering format, responsibilities and permissions.
Decision-note template with the approval status left pending.
briefs.nextAction: Ask the community lead to confirm the purpose of the proposed intake before any external outreach is prepared.

briefs.title: United Kingdom - Support response working pack
briefs.purpose: Prepare a draft response working pack for a possible United Kingdom community-support workstream. The examples should organize tone and escalation questions without promising response times, refunds, delivery outcomes or changes to published customer policies.
workItems: List the types of questions that need a reviewed response, using anonymous categories rather than real customer conversations or account details.
Provide a response structure that acknowledges the question, refers to a verified information source and identifies the appropriate internal next step.
Mark policy-dependent wording and unresolved product facts as pending review instead of filling gaps with assumed commitments.
Create an escalation note with a short issue summary, relevant reference and review status while keeping sensitive customer information in the approved support system.
deliverables: Draft response structure for anonymous question categories.
Policy and product-fact review checklist.
Internal escalation-note template without personal customer data.
briefs.nextAction: Ask the community lead which published information sources and escalation roles should support this working pack.

briefs.title: Germany - Community content and moderation review
briefs.purpose: Prepare a draft moderation review for a possible Germany community workstream. The aim is to record consistent internal decisions and accessibility questions while leaving platform rules, local wording and any escalation process subject to the appropriate review.
workItems: Create anonymous example categories for questions, constructive feedback and content that needs an internal moderation decision.
Provide fields for the source channel, issue category, reviewer reasoning and the next internal action without reproducing personal account details.
Include a review step for clear wording, readable visual text and alternative-text needs when community content is proposed for reuse.
Keep proposed responses and moderation actions as draft examples until the community lead confirms the applicable platform and internal process references.
deliverables: Draft moderation decision log using anonymous categories.
Community-content accessibility review checklist.
Open-question list for response wording and escalation ownership.
briefs.nextAction: Ask the community lead to identify the relevant channels and review the proposed decision categories.

briefs.title: United Arab Emirates - Community event concept checklist
briefs.purpose: Outline a draft checklist for a possible United Arab Emirates community event concept. Dubai is a workspace location reference only; no venue, booking, participant list, event date or partner arrangement is confirmed by this brief.
workItems: Record a proposed purpose and participation format, with blank fields for the internal owner and any later venue or partner references.
List practical questions about access needs, attendee communication, content capture and support responsibilities before a concept moves to review.
Provide a separate permission-review step for photographs or community stories, without assuming that participation grants permission to publish material.
Prepare an internal review note that separates the concept, unresolved dependencies and any later approval decision, leaving budget and timing unconfirmed.
deliverables: Draft event concept cover sheet.
Practical access, communication and permission question checklist.
Pending-decision note for the community lead.
briefs.nextAction: Ask the community lead whether an event concept should be explored and which internal teams need to review it.

briefs.title: Türkiye - Community welcome and knowledge handover
briefs.purpose: Create a draft welcome-resource and knowledge-handover brief for a possible Türkiye community workstream. Keep the country-level workspace reference without inventing a city, local office, staff contact or confirmed community programme.
workItems: List the proposed welcome-resource topics and identify which existing product, website or community information source should support each topic.
Provide space for a local reviewer to check wording and context before any welcome message is approved or shared.
Record unresolved questions and the internal team best placed to answer them, leaving named owners and response dates unassigned.
Prepare a handover index that links approved source material to the latest draft and keeps outdated or unreviewed wording clearly separate.
deliverables: Draft welcome-resource topic index.
Local wording and source-verification question log.
Knowledge-handover template with review status and version fields.
briefs.nextAction: Ask the community lead to select the initial resource topics and assign a reviewer before drafting welcome copy.
